title: Enhancing Local and Global Structure in Compressed AI Agent Memory
title_zh: 增强压缩AI智能体内存中的局部与全局结构

paragraphs.en: AI agents store text as embedding vectors and compress them at scale. A compression is accepted when each item’s nearest neighbors survive, but agents also consolidate, delete, and compare memories, tasks that depend on which items lie far apart. We evaluate both ends with two label-free fidelities from our prior work: the local fidelity L L at 10 neighbors and the global fidelity G G at 30 to 50 percent of the memory. At 96 bytes per passage, rescored binary codes reach an L L of 0.97 yet move 10.1 percent of passages to another theme; PCA with 8-bit codes, at an L L of 0.77, moves 1.7 percent. Rescoring leaves the stored codes, and thus G G , unchanged. We prove that across the G G band, 1 − ν k 1-\nu_{k} is at most 2 to 2.18 times the square root of the near–far rank-violation rate, and that this rate follows the distance noise of the compression (correlation 0.979). Our locality-aware quantization (LAQ) turns the bound into a hinge objective on the codebooks of an OPQ index, keeping its bytes, rotation, and search. To our knowledge, LAQ is the first quantizer whose objective comes from a proven bound on the far end. Reconstruction alone raises G G in 0 of 52 held-out runs; the far hinge raises it in all 52. LAQ raises G G in all 52 ( p = 8.5 × 10 − 4 p=8.5\times 10^{-4} over 13 memory–encoder groups), including the external FinDER memory, has the highest G G of seven equal-size quantizers in all 12 Multi-Doc-2025 runs, scales to a million passages, and keeps evidence recall.
paragraphs.zh: AI 智能体将文本存储为嵌入向量，并在大规模场景下对其进行压缩。 当每个条目的最近邻得以保留时，压缩即可被接受，但智能体还需要整合、删除和比较记忆，这些任务依赖于哪些条目彼此相距较远。 我们使用先前工作中提出的两种无需标签的保真度来评估两端：10 个邻居处的局部保真度 L L，以及 30% 到 50% 记忆规模处的全局保真度 G G。 在每条段落 96 字节时，重打分的二进制编码可达到 0.97 的 L L，却使 10.1% 的段落被移到另一个主题；采用 8 位编码的 PCA 在 L L 为 0.77 时，仅移动 1.7%。 重打分不会改变已存储的编码，因此 G G 保持不变。 我们证明，在整个 G G 区间内，1 − ν k 1-\nu_{k} 至多为近远序违背率平方根的 2 到 2.18 倍，且该违背率遵循压缩的距离噪声（相关系数 0.979）。 我们的局部性感知量化（LAQ）将该界转化为 OPQ 索引码书上的一种铰链目标函数，同时保留其字节数、旋转和搜索方式。 据我们所知，LAQ 是第一个其目标函数来自远端已证明之界的量化器。 仅靠重构在 52 个留出运行中 0 次提升 G G；而远端铰链项在全部 52 个运行中都提升了它。 LAQ 在全部 52 个运行中都提升了 G G（在 13 个记忆-编码器组上 p = 8.5 × 10 − 4 p=8.5\times 10^{-4}），包括外部的 FinDER 记忆，在全部 12 个 Multi-Doc-2025 运行中于七个等尺寸量化器中拥有最高的 G G，可扩展到一百万条段落，并保持证据召回率。

paragraphs.en: Language-model agents remember by embedding what they read, say, and do. When they need an item, they recall the nearest embeddings [ 1 ] . Managed agent memories extract records from conversations, retrieve them by semantic search, and consolidate them over time [ 2 ] . At millions of vectors, every byte per vector costs memory, latency, and money. The vectors are therefore compressed: by truncating Matryoshka embeddings [ 3 ] , by projection, by scalar or binary codes, or by product quantization [ 4 ] . Cloud services offer each of these as a switch [ 5 , 6 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 语言模型智能体通过嵌入它们读取、说出和执行的内容来记忆。 当它们需要某个条目时，就检索最近的嵌入 [ 1 ]。 托管型智能体记忆从对话中提取记录，通过语义搜索检索它们，并随时间对它们进行整合 [ 2 ]。 当向量达到数百万量级时，每个向量多出的每一个字节都意味着内存、延迟和成本。 因此向量需要被压缩：方法包括截断马特里欧什卡嵌入 [ 3 ]、投影、标量或二值编码，以及乘积量化 [ 4 ]。 云服务将上述每一种方法都作为可选开关提供 [ 5 , 6 ]。

paragraphs.en: How should an agent memory be compressed so that it keeps both what lies near and what lies far? Today, a compression is accepted by its nearest neighbors. Vendors report that binary embeddings retain 97 to 98.5 percent of retrieval accuracy [ 5 ] and evaluate quantized indexes by recall@100 [ 6 ] . At 96 bytes per passage on FinQA, rescored binary codes keep L L at 0.97 and top-10 agreement at 0.87, yet move 10.1 percent of passages to another theme (Section VI ). Embedding compression studies report nDCG@10 [ 7 ] or benchmark task scores [ 8 ] . Yet an agent also acts on what lies far apart: it consolidates a year of filings into themes [ 9 , 10 ] , deletes every item of a client or a session on request, and maps how companies and sectors relate. Because these operations compare each item with the whole memory, they decide what a sector brief says and what a deletion removes. Keeping this far end is difficult for two reasons: a private agent memory has no labels to test it with, and quantizers are trained for reconstruction, nearest neighbors, or query relevance. Our idea is to measure the far end with the same statistic that measures the near end, prove which pairwise order controls it, and train the codebooks on that order.
paragraphs.zh: 应当如何压缩智能体记忆，才能使其同时保留近处与远处的内容？ 如今，一次压缩是由其最近邻来评判接受的。 厂商报告称二值嵌入能保留 97 至 98.5% 的检索准确率 [ 5 ]，并以 recall@100 来评估量化索引 [ 6 ]。 在 FinQA 上每段 96 字节时，重打分的二值编码使 L L 保持在 0.97，top-10 一致性为 0.87，却有 10.1% 的段落被移到了另一个主题（第 VI 节）。 嵌入压缩研究报告 nDCG@10 [ 7 ] 或基准任务得分 [ 8 ]。 然而智能体还要作用于相距很远的内容：它把一年的申报文件整合成主题 [ 9 , 10 ]，按请求删除某客户或某会话的每一条目，并映射公司与行业之间的关系。 由于这些操作将每个条目与整段记忆进行比较，它们决定了行业简报的内容以及删除操作会移除什么。 保住这一远端之所以困难有两个原因：私有智能体记忆没有可用于测试的标签，而量化器是为重构、最近邻或查询相关性而训练的。 我们的想法是用衡量近端的同一统计量来衡量远端，证明哪种成对顺序控制着它，并基于该顺序训练码本。

paragraphs.en: At the same bytes and search, our proposed locality-aware quantization (LAQ) keeps the nearest neighbors of a held-out financial memory while moving far fewer passages to another theme (Figure 1 a–c). In such a memory, passages from a single company form islands: in the outer fifth of the map, all 10 nearest neighbors of each passage belong to its own company. Passages from different banks meet in shared themes. At 128 bytes per passage, an optimized product quantization (OPQ) index [ 16 ] keeps local fidelity L L at 0.85 but moves 224 of the 2,688 passages to another theme. LAQ keeps the bytes, the search, and L L at 0.85, while moving only 94 passages.
paragraphs.zh: 在相同字节数和检索量下，我们提出的局部性感知量化（LAQ）能在将远更少的段落移到另一主题的同时，保留一个留出金融记忆库中段落的最近邻（图 1 a–c）。 在这样的记忆库中，来自同一家公司的段落形成孤岛：在地图外侧五分之一的区域内，每个段落的全部 10 个最近邻都属于同一家公司。 来自不同银行的段落会在共享主题中相遇。 在每段落 128 字节时，优化的乘积量化（OPQ）索引 [ 16 ] 将局部保真度 L L 保持在 0.85，但会把 2,688 个段落中的 224 个移到另一主题。 LAQ 在保持字节数、检索量和 L L 为 0.85 的同时，仅移动 94 个段落。

paragraphs.en: One label-free profile reads both ends of a compressed memory. Following our earlier work [ 17 ] , we evaluate the two ends of a chance-corrected locality profile [ 18 ] : the near end (local structure) and the far end (global structure). Local fidelity L L is chance-corrected recall@10. Global fidelity G G averages, over 30 to 50 percent of the memory, the agreement on which items lie in each item’s nearer part. At its upper edge, the profile measures agreement on the near and far halves, which under a Gaussian copula equals Kendall’s τ \tau of the distances. Both fidelities require only the vectors before and after compression, and G G is estimated from a subsample of 2,000 items, however large the memory.
paragraphs.zh: 一次免标签的评估即可读取压缩记忆的两端。 沿用我们早期的工作 [ 17 ]，我们评估机会校正的局部性画像 [ 18 ] 的两端：近端（局部结构）和远端（全局结构）。 局部保真度 L L 是机会校正的 recall@10。 全局保真度 G G 在记忆的 30% 到 50% 范围上，对每个条目较近部分应包含哪些条目的判断一致性取平均。 在画像的上边缘，度量的是近半与远半之间的一致性，在高斯 copula 下这等于距离的 Kendall τ \tau。 两种保真度都只需要压缩前后的向量，并且无论记忆多大，G G 都从 2,000 个条目的子样本中估计。

sents.en: One label-free profile reads both ends of a compressed memory.
sents.zh: 一次免标签的评估即可读取压缩记忆的两端。

sents.zh: 局部保真度 L L 是机会校正的 recall@10。

paragraphs.en: We prove that rank violations among cross pairs control the profile at every scale. A cross pair consists of one near item and one far item relative to an anchor. Let ν k \nu_{k} be the profile at scale k k and N = n − 1 N=n-1 for a memory of n n items. Then 1 − ν k 1-\nu_{k} is at most N / k ⁡ ( N − k ) N/\sqrt{k(N-k)} times the square root of the cross-pair violation rate. The leading factor stays between 2 and 2.18 across the G G band. A hinge loss on distance gaps bounds this violation rate. LAQ lowers this hinge at middle and far scales by refining the codebooks of an OPQ index without labels or queries. The principal component analysis (PCA) basis, rotation, bytes per item, and search remain identical to those of the OPQ index.
paragraphs.zh: 我们证明，交叉对之间的秩违例在每个尺度上都控制着轮廓。 交叉对由相对于一个锚点的一个近项目和一个远项目组成。 设 ν k \nu_{k} 为尺度 k k 下的轮廓，对于一个包含 n n 个项目的记忆，N = n − 1 N=n-1。 那么 1 − ν k 1-\nu_{k} 至多为交叉对违例率的 N / k ⁡ ( N − k ) N/\sqrt{k(N-k)} 倍的平方根。 在 G G 区间内，前导因子保持在 2 到 2.18 之间。 作用于距离间隙的铰链损失可以约束这一违例率。 LAQ 通过在没有标签或查询的情况下优化 OPQ 索引的码本，在中尺度和远尺度上降低这一铰链。 主成分分析（PCA）基、旋转、每项目字节数以及搜索方式都与 OPQ 索引保持一致。

sents.en: We prove that rank violations among cross pairs control the profile at every scale.
sents.zh: 我们证明，交叉对之间的秩违例在每个尺度上都控制着轮廓。

sents.en: A cross pair consists of one near item and one far item relative to an anchor.
sents.zh: 交叉对由相对于一个锚点的一个近项目和一个远项目组成。

sents.en: Let ν k \nu_{k} be the profile at scale k k and N = n − 1 N=n-1 for a memory of n n items.
sents.zh: 设 ν k \nu_{k} 为尺度 k k 下的轮廓，对于一个包含 n n 个项目的记忆，N = n − 1 N=n-1。

sents.en: Then 1 − ν k 1-\nu_{k} is at most N / k ⁡ ( N − k ) N/\sqrt{k(N-k)} times the square root of the cross-pair violation rate.
sents.zh: 那么 1 − ν k 1-\nu_{k} 至多为交叉对违例率的 N / k ⁡ ( N − k ) N/\sqrt{k(N-k)} 倍的平方根。

sents.en: The leading factor stays between 2 and 2.18 across the G G band.
sents.zh: 在 G G 区间内，前导因子保持在 2 到 2.18 之间。

sents.en: A hinge loss on distance gaps bounds this violation rate.
sents.zh: 作用于距离间隙的铰链损失可以约束这一违例率。

sents.en: LAQ lowers this hinge at middle and far scales by refining the codebooks of an OPQ index without labels or queries.
sents.zh: LAQ 通过在没有标签或查询的情况下优化 OPQ 索引的码本，在中尺度和远尺度上降低这一铰链。

sents.en: The principal component analysis (PCA) basis, rotation, bytes per item, and search remain identical to those of the OPQ index.
sents.zh: 主成分分析（PCA）基、旋转、每项目字节数以及搜索方式都与 OPQ 索引保持一致。

paragraphs.en: To our knowledge, LAQ is the first quantizer trained on the far end of a memory, and its objective comes from a bound we prove. The closest learned quantizers train codebooks with pairwise or triplet losses. PQN uses triplets from class labels [ 19 ] , and spreading vectors pair a nearest-neighbor triplet loss with an entropy term [ 20 ] . DPQ trains product codes end to end via straight-through assignments [ 21 ] , and JPQ and Distill-VQ train with queries and relevance labels [ 22 , 23 ] . LAQ differs in target, input, and output. Its target is the rank order at 30 to 50 percent of the memory, selected via our theoretical bound; its input is the unlabeled memory alone; and its output modifies only the codebook values of an OPQ index. We arrived at ν k \nu_{k} from our DLP curve [ 18 ] . Rank-based quality criteria [ 24 , 25 ] also count kept neighbors across scales and summarize them by an area that weights the near end. To our knowledge, the far end had no proven meaning until our earlier work showed that its midpoint is a rank correlation of distances [ 17 ] (Propositions 2 – 3 ). This paper takes the far end from a measure to a target. We prove that rank violations bound the profile at every scale (Theorem 1 ), that under noisy order the profile is fixed by one ratio, the distance noise of a compression against the spread of distances (Proposition 4 , Corollary 2 ), and that at an OPQ start the far hinge falls at no first-order cost in reconstruction (Proposition 5 ). To our knowledge, no earlier quantizer, learned or not, trains its codes on the far end of this curve.
paragraphs.zh: 据我们所知，LAQ 是首个在记忆远端训练的量化器，其目标源自我们证明的一个界。 最接近的学习型量化器使用成对或三元组损失来训练码本。 PQN 使用来自类别标签的三元组 [ 19 ]，而 spreading vectors 将最近邻三元组损失与熵项相结合 [ 20 ]。 DPQ 通过直通估计端到端地训练乘积码 [ 21 ]，JPQ 和 Distill-VQ 则使用查询与相关性标签进行训练 [ 22 , 23 ]。 LAQ 在目标、输入和输出上均有所不同。 其目标是通过我们的理论界选定的记忆 30% 到 50% 处的排序；其输入仅为无标签的记忆；其输出仅修改某个 OPQ 索引的码本值。 我们从 DLP 曲线 [ 18 ] 得到了 ν k \nu_{k}。 基于排序的质量准则 [ 24 , 25 ] 也在多个尺度上统计保留的近邻，并用一个对近端加权的面积来汇总它们。 据我们所知，在我们先前的工作证明远端中点是距离的一个秩相关之前 [ 17 ]（命题 2–3），远端一直没有被证明的意义。 本文将远端从一个度量转化为一个目标。 我们证明：排序违例在每一尺度上都约束该曲线（定理 1）；在噪声排序下，该曲线由一个比值决定，即压缩的距离噪声与距离散布之比（命题 4、推论 2）；并且在 OPQ 起点上，远端铰链在不带来一阶重构代价的情况下落下（命题 5）。 据我们所知，此前没有任何量化器——无论是否为学习型的——在这条曲线的远端上训练其编码。

paragraphs.en: Our contributions, in order of importance, are:
paragraphs.zh: 我们的贡献，按重要性排序如下：

paragraphs.en: A quantizer derived from a bound. A new rank-violation bound ties the profile at every scale to the order of cross pairs, and a hinge surrogate makes it trainable. A noisy-order proposition and its corollary predict the violation rate and the profile in the G G band from one ratio, the distance noise of the compression against the spread of distances. A further proposition shows that, at the OPQ start, the far hinge falls at no first-order cost in reconstruction, and the straight-through steps of training meet its condition at every start. Each result comes with a proof. LAQ turns the bound into a label-free objective on the codebooks of an OPQ index and replaces that index at the same bytes and search. The ablation confirms that the gain comes from the far hinge: reconstruction alone raises G G in 0 of 52 held-out runs, the near hinge raises it by 0.0058 on average, and the far hinge raises it in all 52, by 0.0127.
paragraphs.zh: 一种由界导出的量化器。 一个新的秩违反界将每个尺度上的分布曲线与交叉对的顺序联系起来，而一个铰链代理使其可训练。 一个含噪顺序命题及其推论从单个比值——压缩的距离噪声相对于距离的离散程度——预测违反率和 G G 带内的分布曲线。 更进一步的命题表明，在 OPQ 起始处，远铰链的引入在重建上不带来一阶代价，且训练的直通步骤在每次起始时都满足其条件。 每个结果都附有证明。 LAQ 将该界转化为 OPQ 索引码本上的无标签目标函数，并以相同的字节和搜索方式替换该索引。 消融实验证实增益来自远铰链：仅用重建在 52 个保留运行中有 0 次提升 G G，近铰链平均提升 0.0058，而远铰链在全部 52 个运行中都有提升，平均提升 0.0127。

paragraphs.en: Held-out evidence that it works. On held-out companies and conversations across three memories, LAQ raises G G in all 40 runs and L L in 34. The gain is largest with Amazon Titan V2 [ 5 ] , where G G rises by 0.032 to 0.038 on every split, two to five times the gain with the three retrieval-tuned encoders. On FinDER [ 26 ] , an external financial memory run once after the recipe was fixed, LAQ raises both fidelities in all 12 runs. On Multi-Doc-2025 it lifts the lowest theme agreement from 0.80 to 0.89 and has the highest G G among seven quantizers of equal size. Paired tests confirm the gain: G G rises in all 13 memory–encoder groups ( p = 8.5 × 10 − 4 p=8.5\times 10^{-4} , sign test), LAQ has a higher G G than each of six other quantizers in all 12 Multi-Doc-2025 runs, and evidence recall@10 equals that of OPQ ( p = 0.84 p=0.84 ). On a million passages, one training run takes 175 seconds and a second run reproduces the codebooks bit for bit.
paragraphs.zh: 表明其有效性的留出证据。 在三个记忆上的留出公司和对话中，LAQ 在全部 40 次运行中均提升了 G G，在 34 次运行中提升了 L L。 增益在使用 Amazon Titan V2 [ 5 ] 时最大，其 G G 在每个切分上均提升 0.032 至 0.038，是三个面向检索调优的编码器增益的两到五倍。 在 FinDER [ 26 ] 这个于方法固定后仅运行一次的外部金融记忆上，LAQ 在全部 12 次运行中均提升了两种保真度。 在 Multi-Doc-2025 上，它将最低主题一致性从 0.80 提升到 0.89，并在七个同等规模的量化器中拥有最高的 G G。 配对检验证实了该增益：G G 在全部 13 个记忆–编码器组中均上升（ p = 8.5 × 10 − 4 p=8.5\times 10^{-4} ，符号检验），在全部 12 次 Multi-Doc-2025 运行中 LAQ 的 G G 均高于其他六个量化器中的每一个，且证据召回率@10 与 OPQ 相当（ p = 0.84 p=0.84 ）。 在一百万段落规模上，一次训练仅需 175 秒，且第二次运行可逐比特复现码本。

paragraphs.en: Why the gain matters. Each end governs its own operations. Across two agent memories and six encoders, retrieval tracks L L (partial rank correlation 0.83 to 0.99 given G G ). With the retrieval-tuned encoders, consolidation and deletion track G G (0.55 to 0.93 given L L ). Rescoring repairs the near end at query time but leaves the far end of the stored codes unchanged.
paragraphs.zh: 为什么该增益很重要。 每一端各自管理自己的操作。 在两个智能体记忆和六个编码器上，检索与 L L 保持一致（在给定 G G 时的偏秩相关系数为 0.83 至 0.99）。 使用经过检索调优的编码器时，巩固与删除与 G G 保持一致（在给定 L L 时为 0.55 至 0.93）。 重新打分可在查询时修复近端，但不会改变存储编码的远端。

paragraphs.en: We draw on three lines of research and apply them to agent memory: vector quantization, the evaluation of compressed vectors, and local and global structure.
paragraphs.zh: 我们借鉴三条研究路线并将其应用于智能体记忆：向量量化、压缩向量的评估，以及局部与全局结构。

paragraphs.en: Quantizers compress vectors through subspace decomposition, additive codewords, or binary projections. Product quantization (PQ) splits a vector into subvectors and codes each separately [ 4 ] , while OPQ learns a rotation to balance variance across subvectors [ 16 ] . Residual quantization (RQ) [ 27 ] and local search quantization (LSQ++) [ 28 ] represent a vector as a sum of codewords, whereas ScaNN weights quantization error by its impact on query inner products [ 29 ] . For binary representations, iterative quantization (ITQ) rotates the data before taking signs [ 30 ] , and RaBitQ generates randomized binary codes with a theoretical error bound on distance estimates [ 31 ] . Learned quantizers train codebooks end to end. PQN applies an asymmetric triplet loss on labeled images [ 19 ] . UNQ trains a nonlinear encoder for nearest-neighbor search [ 32 ] . Spreading vectors combine a nearest-neighbor triplet loss with an entropy regularizer [ 20 ] . DPQ trains product quantization end to end via soft assignments and straight-through estimators [ 21 ] . In dense retrieval, JPQ, RepCONC, and Distill-VQ optimize quantizers using queries and relevance labels or teacher rankings [ 22 , 33 , 23 ] . Unlike these methods, our proposed LAQ trains codebooks for far-end rank order using the unlabeled memory alone.
paragraphs.zh: 量化器通过子空间分解、加性码字或二值投影来压缩向量。 乘积量化（PQ）将向量拆分为子向量并分别编码 [4]，而 OPQ 学习一个旋转矩阵以平衡各子向量间的方差 [16]。 残差量化（RQ）[27] 和局部搜索量化（LSQ++）[28] 将向量表示为码字之和，而 ScaNN 则根据量化误差对查询内积的影响为其加权 [29]。 对于二值表示，迭代量化（ITQ）在取符号前先对数据进行旋转 [30]，而 RaBitQ 生成随机化二值编码，并对距离估计提供理论误差界 [31]。 学习型量化器以端到端方式训练码本。 PQN 在带标注图像上应用非对称三元组损失 [19]。 UNQ 为最近邻搜索训练非线性编码器 [32]。 Spreading vectors 将最近邻三元组损失与熵正则项相结合 [20]。 DPQ 通过软分配和直通估计器以端到端方式训练乘积量化 [21]。 在稠密检索中，JPQ、RepCONC 和 Distill-VQ 利用查询与相关性标签或教师排序来优化量化器 [22, 33, 23]。 与这些方法不同，我们提出的 LAQ 仅使用无标注的记忆库来训练面向远端排序的码本。

sents.en: In dense retrieval, JPQ, RepCONC, and Distill-VQ optimize quantizers using queries and relevance labels or teacher rankings [ 22 , 33 , 23 ] .
sents.zh: 在稠密检索中，JPQ、RepCONC 和 Distill-VQ 利用查询与相关性标签或教师排序来优化量化器 [22, 33, 23]。

sents.en: Unlike these methods, our proposed LAQ trains codebooks for far-end rank order using the unlabeled memory alone.
sents.zh: 与这些方法不同，我们提出的 LAQ 仅使用无标注的记忆库来训练面向远端排序的码本。

paragraphs.en: Quantized indexes are typically evaluated by nearest-neighbor recall [ 34 , 6 ] , retrieval quality [ 5 , 7 ] , or downstream task scores [ 8 ] . Kisako et al. [8] conjecture that both clustering and retrieval depend on neighborhood geometry, and Kuffo and Boncz [35] find that one-bit codes support the internal clustering an index uses to partition its vectors. Earlier, Turaga et al. [36] showed that fitting a moment-preserving quantizer per cluster preserves a known k k -means partition. In contrast, our measure asks whether the compressed memory keeps both the partition and the global arrangement of the uncompressed memory, with no partition given in advance.
paragraphs.zh: 量化索引通常通过最近邻召回率 [34, 6]、检索质量 [5, 7] 或下游任务得分 [8] 来评估。Kisako 等人 [8] 推测聚类和检索都依赖于邻域几何，而 Kuffo 和 Boncz [35] 发现一比特编码能够支持索引用于划分向量的内部聚类。更早之前，Turaga 等人 [36] 证明在每个簇上拟合一个保矩量化器可以保持已知的 k k-均值划分。 相比之下，我们的度量关注的是压缩后的记忆是否同时保留了未压缩记忆的划分和全局排布，而无需事先给定任何划分。

paragraphs.en: Rank-based quality criteria evaluate neighborhood preservation across scales [ 24 , 25 ] . Lueks et al. [37] split the co-ranking curve into local and global regimes, and recent visualization methods such as DREAMS and CMET balance or score both ends [ 38 , 39 ] . Global embedding structure is also commonly scored by pairwise distance correlation and triplet accuracy [ 40 , 41 ] . In our prior work, we introduced the degree of locality preservation [ 18 ] . In a subsequent study [ 17 ] , we defined the local fidelity L L , global fidelity G G , and entity fidelity on its chance-corrected profile and proved that the profile’s midpoint converges to a rank correlation of distances. We also derived the subsample estimator of G G and applied these fidelities to two-dimensional maps and compressed agent memory. Building on that measurement framework, the present paper proves which pairwise order controls the profile, turns the resulting bound into a trainable quantizer, and evaluates both ends on held-out memories.
paragraphs.zh: 基于秩的质量准则可跨尺度评估邻域保持性 [ 24 , 25 ] 。Lueks 等人 [37] 将共秩曲线划分为局部与全局两个区间，而近期的可视化方法如 DREAMS 和 CMET 则对两端进行平衡或评分 [ 38 , 39 ] 。 全局嵌入结构通常也通过成对距离相关性和三元组准确率来评分 [ 40 , 41 ] 。 在我们先前的工作中，我们引入了局部性保持度 [ 18 ] 。 在随后的研究 [ 17 ] 中，我们在该机会校正的轮廓上定义了局部保真度 L L 、全局保真度 G G 和实体保真度，并证明了该轮廓的中点收敛于距离的秩相关性。 我们还推导了 G G 的子样本估计量，并将这些保真度应用于二维映射和压缩的智能体记忆。 在该测量框架的基础上，本文证明了哪种成对次序控制该轮廓，将由此得到的界转化为可训练的量化器，并在留出的记忆上对两端进行评估。

paragraphs.en: Benchmarks such as LoCoMo [ 15 ] and LongMemEval [ 42 ] evaluate whether agents can recall facts from long interactions. Agent memory systems consolidate new records against the most similar stored entries [ 2 ] , while corpus-level frameworks cluster embeddings into themes and summaries [ 9 , 10 , 43 ] . Whereas these systems compress memory at the text level through summarization and consolidation, we study the compression of the underlying embedding vectors and the memory-wide operations that depend on them.
paragraphs.zh: LoCoMo [15] 和 LongMemEval [42] 等基准测试评估智能体能否从长期交互中回忆事实。 智能体记忆系统将新记录与最相似的已存储条目进行合并 [2]，而语料库级框架则将嵌入向量聚类为主题和摘要 [9, 10, 43]。 这些系统通过摘要和合并技术在文本层面压缩记忆，而我们研究的是底层嵌入向量的压缩以及依赖这些向量的记忆范围操作。

paragraphs.en: One chance-corrected profile measures both ends of a compressed memory, while the relative order of near and far items controls this profile at every scale. This section defines the profile, proves what its two ends measure, defines the local and global fidelities L L and G G , and proves the bound that LAQ optimizes in Section IV .
paragraphs.zh: 一个经机会校正的轮廓同时度量压缩记忆的两端，而远近条目的相对顺序则在每一个尺度上控制该轮廓。 本节定义该轮廓，证明其两端所度量的内容，定义局部与全局保真度 L L 和 G G，并证明第四节中 LAQ 所优化的界。

paragraphs.en: Each fidelity is read from the vectors that its corresponding operations use. When a retrieval pipeline uses rescoring, it fetches the 40 nearest codes and rescores them using full-precision vectors read from disk. Rescoring modifies the lists returned to a query while leaving the stored codes unchanged. We therefore read L L and retrieval from the rescored lists seen by the query. We read G G and every other operation from the stored codes on which those operations run.

paragraphs.en: The order of near and far items controls the profile at every scale. Whereas the profile counts kept neighbors, a learning objective requires a quantity that varies smoothly with the codes. Pairwise rank order provides such a quantity. For item i i , the anchor, and scale k k , we call ( p , q ) (p,q) a cross pair if p ∈ 𝒩 k x ​ ( i ) p\in\mathcal{N}^{x}_{k}(i) and q ∉ 𝒩 k x ​ ( i ) q\notin\mathcal{N}^{x}_{k}(i) ; that is, p p is near and q q is far in the uncompressed memory. Item i i has k ⁡ ( N − k ) k(N-k) cross pairs, and a pair is violated if the compression reverses its order so that r i z ​ ( q ) < r i z ​ ( p ) r^{z}_{i}(q)<r^{z}_{i}(p) . Let p k ​ ( i ) p_{k}(i) be the fraction of violated cross pairs of i i , and let p ¯ k = 1 n ​ ∑ i p k ​ ( i ) \bar{p}_{k}=\frac{1}{n}\sum_{i}p_{k}(i) .
paragraphs.zh: 近邻项与远邻项的顺序在每一个尺度上决定其分布轮廓。 分布轮廓统计的是保留的近邻，而学习目标需要一个随编码平滑变化的量。 成对排序次序恰好提供了这样一个量。 对于条目 i i（即锚点）与尺度 k k，若 p ∈ 𝒩 k x ​ ( i ) p\in\mathcal{N}^{x}_{k}(i) 且 q ∉ 𝒩 k x ​ ( i ) q\notin\mathcal{N}^{x}_{k}(i)，我们称 ( p , q ) (p,q) 为一个跨对；也就是说，在未压缩的记忆中 p p 是近邻而 q q 是远邻。 条目 i i 拥有 k ⁡ ( N − k ) k(N-k) 个跨对，如果压缩颠倒了某一对的次序，使得 r i z ​ ( q ) < r i z ​ ( p ) r^{z}_{i}(q)<r^{z}_{i}(p)，则该跨对被违反。 设 p k ​ ( i ) p_{k}(i) 为条目 i i 被违反的跨对所占比例，并设 p ¯ k = 1 n ​ ∑ i p k ​ ( i ) \bar{p}_{k}=\frac{1}{n}\sum_{i}p_{k}(i)。

sents.en: The order of near and far items controls the profile at every scale.
sents.zh: 近邻项与远邻项的顺序在每一个尺度上决定其分布轮廓。

sents.en: Whereas the profile counts kept neighbors, a learning objective requires a quantity that varies smoothly with the codes.
sents.zh: 分布轮廓统计的是保留的近邻，而学习目标需要一个随编码平滑变化的量。

paragraphs.en: Because rank violations are counted by a step function, we bound them with a hinge on distance gaps. Let Δ x = ‖ x i − x q ‖ 2 − ‖ x i − x p ‖ 2 ≥ 0 \Delta^{x}=\|x_{i}-x_{q}\|^{2}-\|x_{i}-x_{p}\|^{2}\geq 0 be the uncompressed gap of a cross pair, Δ z = ‖ z i − z q ‖ 2 − ‖ z i − z p ‖ 2 \Delta^{z}=\|z_{i}-z_{q}\|^{2}-\|z_{i}-z_{p}\|^{2} be its compressed gap, and h = [ η ​ Δ x − Δ z ] + h=[\eta\Delta^{x}-\Delta^{z}]_{+} with margin η > 0 \eta>0 . paragraphs.zh: 由于排序违反是通过阶跃函数来统计的，我们用基于距离差距的合页函数对其进行约束。 设 Δ x = ‖ x i − x q ‖ 2 − ‖ x i − x p ‖ 2 ≥ 0 \Delta^{x}=\|x_{i}-x_{q}\|^{2}-\|x_{i}-x_{p}\|^{2}\geq 0 为交叉对的未压缩差距，Δ z = ‖ z i − z q ‖ 2 − ‖ z i − z p ‖ 2 \Delta^{z}=\|z_{i}-z_{q}\|^{2}-\|z_{i}-z_{p}\|^{2} 为其压缩后的差距，并且 h = [ η Δ x − Δ z ] + h=[\eta\Delta^{x}-\Delta^{z}]_{+}，其中间隔 η > 0 \eta>0 。 将压缩后的差距推高到未压缩差距的一定比例之上，可以降低违反率，正如下面的推论所示。

paragraphs.en: The far end thus depends on one ratio: how much the compression perturbs the distances from an anchor, against how much those distances spread. At the same distortion, a memory whose distances spread less loses more of its far end, and any quantizer that lowers ω i \omega_{i} in the G G band raises ν k \nu_{k} there. The model rests on a normal approximation of each anchor’s distances. In the G G band, these distances are sums over many directions and lie in the bulk of their distribution. At k = 10 k=10 , they lie in the lower tail, where the local structure of the memory decides. The independence of the residuals also holds approximately: items that share a codeword have correlated errors, and the noise varies across items. Figure 12 tests the consequences of both approximations.
paragraphs.zh: 因此，远端取决于一个比值：压缩对距锚点距离的扰动程度，与这些距离的分散程度之比。 在相同失真下，距离分散更小的记忆会损失更多远端，而任何在 G G 频段降低 ω i \omega_{i} 的量化器都会在该频段提高 ν k \nu_{k}。 该模型建立在每个锚点距离的正态近似之上。 在 G G 频段，这些距离是许多方向上的求和，位于其分布的主体部分。 在 k = 10 k=10 时，它们位于下尾部分，此时由记忆的局部结构决定。 残差的独立性也近似成立：共享同一码字的项具有相关的误差，且噪声在各项之间存在差异。 图 12 检验了这两种近似的后果。

paragraphs.en: The held-out memories bear out both results (Figure 12 in Appendix C ). Standardized by their normal mean and variance, the distances of each anchor match the normal quantile to within a median of 0.10 standard deviations at k = 0.4 ​ n k=0.4n and 0.06 at k = 0.5 ​ n k=0.5n , against 0.42 at k = 10 k=10 . Across all 52 held-out runs, for the OPQ start and LAQ, π ⁡ ( 0.4 , ω i ) \pi(0.4,\omega_{i}) predicts the measured violation rate at k = 0.4 ​ n k=0.4n with correlation 0.979. The median error is 5.3 percent with the retrieval-tuned encoders, and the prediction is 25 to 31 percent low with Titan V2. These predictions use the full integral ( 8 ). Its leading term is larger, by a median of 25 percent with Titan V2, so the gap with Titan V2 lies in the assumptions of the model and not in the expansion. At k = 10 k=10 , the normal model predicts 2.8 times the measured rate (median), so the near end keeps more order than the model allows. Evaluated at the mean relative distance noise of each run, Corollary 2 gives ν k \nu_{k} at k = 0.4 ​ n k=0.4n within a median of 0.005 of the measured value (correlation 0.982). The relative distance noise ranges from 0.16 to 0.37 with the retrieval-tuned encoders and from 0.47 to 0.52 with Titan V2, whose OPQ start keeps the least of the far end. The data entropy of a memory [ 46 ] , h = − ∑ ℓ u ℓ log 2 u ℓ h=-\sum_{\ell}u_{\ell}\log_{2}u_{\ell} with u ℓ u_{\ell} the singular values of the standardized memory divided by their sum, tells how much LAQ lowers this noise. Within each retrieval-tuned encoder, across its 16 held-out runs, h h has a rank correlation of 0.77 to 0.81 with the drop in mean relative distance noise from OPQ to LAQ and of 0.82 to 0.84 with the gain in G G ( p ≤ 4 × 10 − 4 p\leq 4\times 10^{-4} in each case). Memories of higher data entropy spread their information over more directions, and LAQ removes more of their distance noise.

paragraphs.en: Locality-aware quantization (LAQ) trains the codebooks of an OPQ index to keep the order of cross pairs at the middle and far scales, the target identified by Theorem 1 . Whereas product quantizers learn codebooks to reconstruct vectors or keep nearest neighbors, LAQ adds this far-end target, needs no labels, and keeps the rest of the OPQ index intact. Figure 1 g shows the procedure.
paragraphs.zh: 局部性感知量化（LAQ）通过训练 OPQ 索引的码本，使跨对在中尺度和远尺度上保持原有顺序，该目标由定理 1 指出。 乘积量化器学习码本是为了重构向量或保留最近邻，而 LAQ 增加了这一远端目标，无需标签，并保持 OPQ 索引的其余部分不变。 图 1g 展示了该过程。

sents.en: Locality-aware quantization (LAQ) trains the codebooks of an OPQ index to keep the order of cross pairs at the middle and far scales, the target identified by Theorem 1 .

sents.en: Whereas product quantizers learn codebooks to reconstruct vectors or keep nearest neighbors, LAQ adds this far-end target, needs no labels, and keeps the rest of the OPQ index intact.
sents.zh: 乘积量化器学习码本是为了重构向量或保留最近邻，而 LAQ 增加了这一远端目标，无需标签，并保持 OPQ 索引的其余部分不变。

sents.en: Figure 1 g shows the procedure.
sents.zh: 图 1g 展示了该过程。

paragraphs.en: LAQ first fits PCA on the training memory in the full basis, followed by OPQ with M = d / 8 M=d/8 subspaces of eight dimensions and K = 256 K=256 codewords each, storing every item in d / 8 d/8 bytes. Let μ \mu be the mean of the training vectors and R R be the orthogonal map combining the PCA basis with the OPQ rotation. Let y i = R ⁡ ( x i − μ ) y_{i}=R(x_{i}-\mu) denote the rotated item, y i , ℓ y_{i,\ell} its ℓ \ell -th subvector, and C = { c ℓ , j } C=\{c_{\ell,j}\} ( ℓ = 1 , … , M \ell=1,\dots,M , j = 1 , … , K j=1,\dots,K ) the codebooks initialized at the OPQ values C 0 C_{0} . Each item is encoded by its nearest codeword in each subspace and decoded as the concatenation z i ​ ( C ) z_{i}(C) . Because R R is orthogonal, distances in the rotated basis equal those in the original space.
paragraphs.zh: LAQ 先在完整基上对训练记忆拟合 PCA，随后进行 OPQ，使用 M = d/8 个八维子空间，每个子空间有 K = 256 个码字，每条数据以 d/8 字节存储。 设 μ 为训练向量的均值，R 为将 PCA 基与 OPQ 旋转结合起来的正交映射。 设 y_i = R(x_i − μ) 表示旋转后的数据项，y_{i,ℓ} 为其第 ℓ 个子向量，C = {c_{ℓ,j}}（ℓ = 1,…,M，j = 1,…,K）为在 OPQ 初始值 C_0 处初始化的码本。 每条数据项通过在每个子空间中选取最近的码字进行编码，并解码为拼接结果 z_i(C)。 由于 R 是正交的，旋转基中的距离与原空间中的距离相等。

paragraphs.en: LAQ modifies the codebook values and nothing else: the PCA basis, rotation, bytes per item, and asymmetric distance computation (ADC) search all remain identical to those of OPQ. An LAQ index therefore replaces an OPQ index directly and adds no operation at query time. A single recipe serves every memory and encoder: t max = 1,000 t_{\max}=1{,}000 steps, λ mid = λ far = 1 \lambda_{\mathrm{mid}}=\lambda_{\mathrm{far}}=1 , and η = 1 \eta=1 (Appendix B ).
paragraphs.zh: LAQ 仅修改码本取值，其他一概不变：PCA 基、旋转、每项字节数以及非对称距离计算（ADC）搜索都与 OPQ 保持完全一致。 因此，LAQ 索引可以直接替换 OPQ 索引，且在查询时不增加任何操作。 一套配方适用于所有记忆与编码器：t max = 1,000 t_{\max}=1{,}000 步、λ mid = λ far = 1 \lambda_{\mathrm{mid}}=\lambda_{\mathrm{far}}=1，以及 η = 1 \eta=1（附录 B）。

paragraphs.en: Let n n be the number of training items, d d the dimension, K = 256 K=256 the codebook size, B = 2,048 B=2{,}048 the number of cross pairs per step (1,024 anchors in each of the two groups), and t max t_{\max} the number of steps. Ranking the training memory once costs O ⁡ ( n 2 ​ ( d + log ⁡ n ) ) O(n^{2}(d+\log n)) time and O ⁡ ( n 2 ) O(n^{2}) memory. Each step encodes all items with the current codebooks in O ⁡ ( n ​ K ​ d ) O(nKd) time and evaluates the hinge on B B cross pairs in O ⁡ ( B ​ d ) O(Bd) time. Training therefore costs O ⁡ ( n 2 ​ ( d + log ⁡ n ) + t max ​ ( n ​ K ​ d + B ​ d ) ) O(n^{2}(d+\log n)+t_{\max}(nKd+Bd)) time in total, while the query cost and the encoding of a new item, O ⁡ ( K ​ d ) O(Kd) , remain those of OPQ. The n × n n\times n matrix of 7,336 to 7,672 items fits on one 48 GB GPU, and the 1,000 steps take 35 to 112 seconds on Multi-Doc-2025. For a memory of a million items, a scalable variant ranks against m = 8,192 m=8{,}192 reference items at each step and decodes only the items used in that step, with a reconstruction batch of b = 16,384 b=16{,}384 . This reduces the per-step cost to O ⁡ ( B ​ m ​ ( d + log ⁡ m ) + ( B + b ) ​ K ​ d ) O(Bm(d+\log m)+(B+b)Kd) and memory to O ⁡ ( n ​ d + B ​ m ) O(nd+Bm) (Section VII-E ).
paragraphs.zh: 设 n n 为训练条目数，d d 为维度，K = 256 K=256 为码本大小，B = 2,048 B=2{,}048 为每步的跨组配对数（两个组中各有 1,024 个锚点），t max t_{\max} 为步数。 对训练记忆进行一次排序需要 O ⁡ ( n 2 ​ ( d + log ⁡ n ) ) O(n^{2}(d+\log n)) 的时间和 O ⁡ ( n 2 ) O(n^{2}) 的内存。 每一步在 O ⁡ ( n ​ K ​ d ) O(nKd) 时间内用当前码本对所有条目进行编码，并在 O ⁡ ( B ​ d ) O(Bd) 时间内对 B B 个跨组配对计算合页损失。 因此训练总耗时为 O ⁡ ( n 2 ​ ( d + log ⁡ n ) + t max ​ ( n ​ K ​ d + B ​ d ) ) O(n^{2}(d+\log n)+t_{\max}(nKd+Bd))，而查询开销和新条目的编码开销 O ⁡ ( K ​ d ) O(Kd) 与 OPQ 保持一致。 由 7,336 到 7,672 个条目构成的 n × n n\times n 矩阵可放入单块 48 GB GPU，在 Multi-Doc-2025 上 1,000 步耗时 35 到 112 秒。 对于包含一百万条目的记忆，一种可扩展的变体在每一步仅针对 m = 8,192 m=8{,}192 个参考条目进行排序，并且只解码该步中用到的条目，重建批大小为 b = 16,384 b=16{,}384。 这将每步开销降为 O ⁡ ( B ​ m ​ ( d + log ⁡ m ) + ( B + b ) ​ K ​ d ) O(Bm(d+\log m)+(B+b)Kd)，内存降为 O ⁡ ( n ​ d + B ​ m ) O(nd+Bm)（见第 VII-E 节）。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate the two fidelities across five memories and six encoders, and test LAQ on held-out splits of four memories as well as on a million-passage memory.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在五个记忆库和六种编码器上评估这两种保真度，并在四个记忆库的保留划分以及一个百万段落的记忆库上测试 LAQ。

paragraphs.en: Table I lists five memories: three agent memories and two topic corpora. FinQA, LoCoMo, and the topic corpora serve the measurement, and Multi-Doc-2025 and two additional memories test LAQ. FinQA [ 14 ] contains pages from the annual reports of S&P 500 companies paired with numerical questions annotated with supporting facts. We retain the 106 companies in the current index and up to three report pages per company. Every sentence and table row is one item, prefixed by the company name and fiscal year. This yields 8,356 items across 11 Global Industry Classification Standard (GICS) sectors and 863 questions. Multi-Doc-2025 [ 11 ] is a financial question-answering benchmark spanning 179 10-K filings from 89 S&P 500 companies for fiscal years 2022 to 2024. Each paragraph and table row serves as a candidate item with the same prefix. Every filing retains the passages containing its questions’ evidence plus a random sample, up to 56 passages, yielding 10,024 items and 898 questions with located evidence. Multi-Doc-2025 is used to test LAQ. LoCoMo [ 15 ] is a long-term conversational memory benchmark for agents, comprising ten conversations of 19 to 32 sessions, 5,882 turns, and 1,536 answerable questions annotated with their evidence turns. Each turn, prefixed by its speaker, forms one item. 20 Newsgroups [ 48 ] and AG News [ 49 ] contribute 10,000 random documents each, spanning 20 and 4 topics, respectively. A sixth memory, FinDER [ 26 ] , is reserved for testing LAQ: it pairs 5,703 queries written by financial professionals with expert-selected evidence from the 10-K filings of 497 S&P 500 companies. Following our Multi-Doc-2025 construction, we keep up to 30 passages per filing. Because FinDER provides the evidence text without specifying its company, we locate each excerpt in the filing that contains the most of its rarer words. When multiple filings match, the company named in the query breaks the tie, and any excerpt located in a company other than the one named is dropped. Taking the one or two passages in that filing whose words appear in the excerpt as the evidence passages yields 14,949 items and 5,129 questions. Finally, a seventh memory comprising 1,000,000 passages from MS MARCO [ 50 ] tests LAQ at scale (Section VII-E ).
paragraphs.zh: 表 I 列出了五个记忆库：三个智能体记忆库和两个主题语料库。 FinQA、LoCoMo 和主题语料库用于测量，Multi-Doc-2025 和另外两个记忆库用于测试 LAQ。 FinQA [ 14 ] 包含标普 500 公司年报页面，并配有标注了支持性事实的数值型问题。 我们保留了当前指数中的 106 家公司，以及每家公司至多三页报告页面。 每个句子和表格行构成一个条目，并以公司名称和财年作为前缀。 这产生了涵盖 11 个全球行业分类标准（GICS）板块的 8,356 个条目和 863 个问题。 Multi-Doc-2025 [ 11 ] 是一个金融问答基准，涵盖 89 家标普 500 公司 2022 至 2024 财年的 179 份 10-K 文件。 每个段落和表格行都作为一个带有相同前缀的候选条目。 每份文件保留包含其问题证据的段落以及一个随机样本，至多 56 个段落，从而产生 10,024 个条目和 898 个已定位证据的问题。 Multi-Doc-2025 用于测试 LAQ。 LoCoMo [ 15 ] 是一个面向智能体的长期对话记忆基准，包含十段对话，涵盖 19 至 32 个会话、5,882 轮对话，以及 1,536 个标注了证据轮次的可回答问题。 每一轮对话以其说话者为前缀，构成一个条目。20 Newsgroups [ 48 ] 和 AG News [ 49 ] 各贡献 10,000 个随机文档，分别涵盖 20 个和 4 个主题。 第六个记忆库 FinDER [ 26 ] 保留用于测试 LAQ：它将 5,703 个由金融专业人士撰写的问题与从 497 家标普 500 公司的 10-K 文件中精选的专家证据配对。 遵循我们构建 Multi-Doc-2025 的方法，我们保留每份文件至多 30 个段落。 由于 FinDER 提供证据文本但未指明其所属公司，我们在包含其较多罕见词的文件中定位每个摘录。 当多份文件匹配时，以问题中提及的公司来打破平局，任何定位到非所提及公司的摘录都被剔除。 取该文件中词语出现在摘录中的一个或两个段落作为证据段落，产生 14,949 个条目和 5,129 个问题。 最后，第七个记忆库包含来自 MS MARCO [ 50 ] 的 1,000,000 个段落，用于在大规模下测试 LAQ（第 VII-E 节）。

paragraphs.en: Six encoders serve the fidelity measurement runs. Three are retrieval-tuned sentence encoders used with their query instructions: BGE-base-en-v1.5 (BGE-base) and BGE-large-en-v1.5 (BGE-large) [ 12 ] at 768 and 1,024 dimensions, and E5-base-v2 (E5-base) [ 51 ] at 768 dimensions. Three are encoders of other kinds: the text encoder of MobileCLIP2-L/14 [ 45 ] (768 dimensions), RoBERTa-base [ 52 ] with mean pooling (768), and averaged GloVe vectors [ 53 ] (300). A seventh encoder, the commercial Amazon Titan Text Embeddings V2 (Titan V2) [ 5 ] at 1,024 dimensions, is used on Multi-Doc-2025 to test LAQ. All vectors have unit length.
paragraphs.zh: 六个编码器用于保真度测量运行。 其中三个是经过检索微调的句子编码器，使用时附带各自的查询指令：BGE-base-en-v1.5（BGE-base）和 BGE-large-en-v1.5（BGE-large）[ 12 ]，维度分别为 768 和 1,024，以及 E5-base-v2（E5-base）[ 51 ]，维度为 768。 另外三个是其他类型的编码器：MobileCLIP2-L/14 [ 45 ] 的文本编码器（768 维）、采用平均池化的 RoBERTa-base [ 52 ]（768 维），以及取平均的 GloVe 词向量 [ 53 ]（300 维）。 第七个编码器是商业化的 Amazon Titan Text Embeddings V2（Titan V2）[ 5 ]，维度为 1,024，用于在 Multi-Doc-2025 上测试 LAQ。 所有向量的长度均为单位长度。

sents.en: Six encoders serve the fidelity measurement runs.
sents.zh: 六个编码器用于保真度测量运行。

sents.en: Three are retrieval-tuned sentence encoders used with their query instructions: BGE-base-en-v1.5 (BGE-base) and BGE-large-en-v1.5 (BGE-large) [ 12 ] at 768 and 1,024 dimensions, and E5-base-v2 (E5-base) [ 51 ] at 768 dimensions.
sents.zh: 其中三个是经过检索微调的句子编码器，使用时附带各自的查询指令：BGE-base-en-v1.5（BGE-base）和 BGE-large-en-v1.5（BGE-large）[ 12 ]，维度分别为 768 和 1,024，以及 E5-base-v2（E5-base）[ 51 ]，维度为 768。

sents.en: Three are encoders of other kinds: the text encoder of MobileCLIP2-L/14 [ 45 ] (768 dimensions), RoBERTa-base [ 52 ] with mean pooling (768), and averaged GloVe vectors [ 53 ] (300).
sents.zh: 另外三个是其他类型的编码器：MobileCLIP2-L/14 [ 45 ] 的文本编码器（768 维）、采用平均池化的 RoBERTa-base [ 52 ]（768 维），以及取平均的 GloVe 词向量 [ 53 ]（300 维）。

sents.en: A seventh encoder, the commercial Amazon Titan Text Embeddings V2 (Titan V2) [ 5 ] at 1,024 dimensions, is used on Multi-Doc-2025 to test LAQ.
sents.zh: 第七个编码器是商业化的 Amazon Titan Text Embeddings V2（Titan V2）[ 5 ]，维度为 1,024，用于在 Multi-Doc-2025 上测试 LAQ。

sents.en: All vectors have unit length.
sents.zh: 所有向量的长度均为单位长度。

paragraphs.en: There are 18 measurement runs: the six encoders on the two agent memories FinQA and LoCoMo, and the three encoders of other kinds on the two topic corpora. Each run applies 27 compressions fitted on the memory itself. Scalar codes comprise half precision along with 8- and 4-bit codes. Binary codes comprise 1-bit sign codes, the same codes with full-precision rescoring of the 40 nearest candidates, and 2- and 4-bit thermometer codes that set one bit per threshold passed on each coordinate. Truncation, PCA, and Gaussian random projection reduce vectors to d / 2 d/2 , d / 4 d/4 , d / 8 d/8 , and d / 16 d/16 dimensions. In addition, PCA to d / 4 d/4 and d / 8 d/8 is stored with 8-bit codes, and PCA to d d and d / 2 d/2 is followed by a random rotation and binarization. Product quantization uses d / 8 d/8 , d / 16 d/16 , and d / 32 d/32 bytes, while UMAP [ 44 ] maps vectors to 16 dimensions. Finally, OPQ with and without rescoring is included at d / 8 d/8 bytes. For comparison, t-SNE [ 13 ] , SR-tSNE [ 54 ] , PHATE [ 55 ] , Isomap [ 56 ] , and nonnegative PCA (NPCA) [ 57 ] are fitted on FinQA and LoCoMo with BGE-base (Table IV ). Binary codes are compared by Hamming distance and all other codes by Euclidean distance on the decoded vectors. In our figures, PCA with 8-bit codes is labeled PCA + int8 and rescored binary codes binary + rescoring. Binarization after PCA and a random rotation is labeled PCA + rotation + binary (PCA + rot. + binary where space is short).
paragraphs.zh: 共有 18 组测量运行：两个智能体记忆 FinQA 和 LoCoMo 上的六个编码器，以及两个主题语料库上的另外三种编码器。 每次运行都在该记忆本身上拟合应用 27 种压缩。 标量编码包括半精度以及 8 位和 4 位编码。 二值编码包括 1 位符号编码、对 40 个最近候选进行全精度重评分的相同编码，以及在每个坐标上每通过一个阈值就置一位的 2 位和 4 位温度计编码。 截断、PCA 和高斯随机投影将向量降维到 d / 2 d/2、d / 4 d/4、d / 8 d/8 和 d / 16 d/16 维。 此外，PCA 到 d / 4 d/4 和 d / 8 d/8 的结果以 8 位编码存储，而 PCA 到 d d 和 d / 2 d/2 的结果随后经过随机旋转和二值化。 乘积量化使用 d / 8 d/8、d / 16 d/16 和 d / 32 d/32 字节，而 UMAP [ 44 ] 将向量映射到 16 维。 最后，带重评分与不带重评分的 OPQ 以 d / 8 d/8 字节的形式纳入其中。 作为对比，t-SNE [ 13 ]、SR-tSNE [ 54 ]、PHATE [ 55 ]、Isomap [ 56 ] 和非负 PCA（NPCA）[ 57 ] 使用 BGE-base 在 FinQA 和 LoCoMo 上拟合（表 IV）。 二值编码通过汉明距离进行比较，所有其他编码则通过解码向量上的欧氏距离进行比较。 在我们的图中，带 8 位编码的 PCA 标注为 PCA + int8，重评分的二值编码标注为 binary + rescoring。 PCA 加随机旋转后的二值化标注为 PCA + rotation + binary（空间不足时写作 PCA + rot. + binary）。

sents.zh: 作为对比，t-SNE [ 13 ]、SR-tSNE [ 54 ]、PHATE [ 55 ]、Isomap [ 56 ] 和非负 PCA（NPCA）[ 57 ] 使用 BGE-base 在 FinQA 和 LoCoMo 上拟合（表 IV）。

paragraphs.en: Each operation is executed on both the compressed and uncompressed memories, and we report their agreement. We model an agent’s memory operations directly on the vectors, which scores every operation on every compression without a language model in the loop.
paragraphs.zh: 每个操作都在压缩记忆与未压缩记忆上执行，并报告二者的一致性。 我们直接在向量上对智能体的记忆操作建模，从而在没有语言模型参与的情况下对每次压缩上的每个操作进行评分。

sents.en: Each operation is executed on both the compressed and uncompressed memories, and we report their agreement.
sents.zh: 每个操作都在压缩记忆与未压缩记忆上执行，并报告二者的一致性。

sents.en: We model an agent’s memory operations directly on the vectors, which scores every operation on every compression without a language model in the loop.
sents.zh: 我们直接在向量上对智能体的记忆操作建模，从而在没有语言模型参与的情况下对每次压缩上的每个操作进行评分。

paragraphs.en: Retrieval. Each question retrieves its 10 nearest items (within its conversation for LoCoMo). Agreement is the overlap of the two top-10 lists, while quality is evidence recall@10, the share of a question’s evidence among those 10 items.
paragraphs.zh: 检索。 每个问题检索其最近的10个条目（对于LoCoMo，在其对话范围内）。 一致性是指两个top-10列表的重叠程度，而质量则是指证据召回率@10，即问题的证据在这10个条目中所占的比例。

sents.en: Retrieval.
sents.zh: 检索。

sents.en: Each question retrieves its 10 nearest items (within its conversation for LoCoMo).
sents.zh: 每个问题检索其最近的10个条目（对于LoCoMo，在其对话范围内）。

sents.en: Agreement is the overlap of the two top-10 lists, while quality is evidence recall@10, the share of a question’s evidence among those 10 items.
sents.zh: 一致性是指两个top-10列表的重叠程度，而质量则是指证据召回率@10，即问题的证据在这10个条目中所占的比例。

paragraphs.en: Consolidation into themes. We run k k -means on the compressed memory, initialized from the centroids of the uncompressed partition, using 11 themes for the financial memories and 20 and 4 themes for the topic corpora. Agreement is measured by the adjusted Rand index (ARI) [ 58 ] , which we call theme agreement.
paragraphs.zh: 归并为主题。 我们在压缩后的记忆上运行 k k-均值聚类，以未压缩划分的质心作为初始化，对金融记忆使用 11 个主题，对主题语料库分别使用 20 个和 4 个主题。 一致性通过调整兰德指数（ARI）[58] 来衡量，我们称之为主题一致性。

sents.en: Consolidation into themes.
sents.zh: 归并为主题。

sents.en: We run k k -means on the compressed memory, initialized from the centroids of the uncompressed partition, using 11 themes for the financial memories and 20 and 4 themes for the topic corpora.
sents.zh: 我们在压缩后的记忆上运行 k k-均值聚类，以未压缩划分的质心作为初始化，对金融记忆使用 11 个主题，对主题语料库分别使用 20 个和 4 个主题。

sents.en: Agreement is measured by the adjusted Rand index (ARI) [ 58 ] , which we call theme agreement.
sents.zh: 一致性通过调整兰德指数（ARI）[58] 来衡量，我们称之为主题一致性。

paragraphs.en: Deletion. For each session or topic, the memory selects as many items as the session or topic contains, choosing those nearest its centroid. This models how a memory identifies deletion candidates by meaning when metadata are incomplete. Agreement is the Jaccard overlap of the deleted sets.
paragraphs.zh: 删除。 对于每个会话或主题，记忆会选取与会话或主题所含数量相同的条目，选择那些最接近其质心的条目。 这模拟了当元数据不完整时，记忆如何根据语义识别删除候选对象。 一致度是被删除集合之间的 Jaccard 重叠度。

sents.en: Deletion.
sents.zh: 删除。

sents.en: For each session or topic, the memory selects as many items as the session or topic contains, choosing those nearest its centroid.
sents.zh: 对于每个会话或主题，记忆会选取与会话或主题所含数量相同的条目，选择那些最接近其质心的条目。

sents.en: This models how a memory identifies deletion candidates by meaning when metadata are incomplete.
sents.zh: 这模拟了当元数据不完整时，记忆如何根据语义识别删除候选对象。

sents.en: Agreement is the Jaccard overlap of the deleted sets.
sents.zh: 一致度是被删除集合之间的 Jaccard 重叠度。

paragraphs.en: Company operations. The information barrier walls off a company by applying deletion to it, while peer groups consist of each company’s five nearest companies by centroid. The company map is the rank correlation between distances among compressed company centroids and the uncompressed ones; the sector, session, and topic maps are defined in the same way.
paragraphs.zh: 公司运营。 信息壁垒通过对某公司施加删除来将其隔离，而同侪组由质心距离最近的五家公司构成。 公司图谱是压缩后的公司质心之间距离与未压缩质心之间距离的秩相关；行业图谱、会话图谱和主题图谱以相同方式定义。

sents.en: Company operations.
sents.zh: 公司运营。

sents.en: The information barrier walls off a company by applying deletion to it, while peer groups consist of each company’s five nearest companies by centroid.
sents.zh: 信息壁垒通过对某公司施加删除来将其隔离，而同侪组由质心距离最近的五家公司构成。

sents.en: The company map is the rank correlation between distances among compressed company centroids and the uncompressed ones; the sector, session, and topic maps are defined in the same way.
sents.zh: 公司图谱是压缩后的公司质心之间距离与未压缩质心之间距离的秩相关；行业图谱、会话图谱和主题图谱以相同方式定义。

paragraphs.en: Global references. These use the subsamples of G G . All distances is the Spearman correlation across 200,000 pairwise distances [ 40 ] . Triplets is the accuracy on random triplets [ 41 ] . The median split is ν k ⋆ \nu_{k^{\star}} from Proposition 2 .
paragraphs.zh: 全局参考。 这些使用 G G 的子样本。 所有距离均为 200,000 个成对距离上的 Spearman 相关 [ 40 ]。 Triplets 为随机三元组上的准确率 [ 41 ]。 中位数划分为来自命题 2 的 ν k ⋆ \nu_{k^{\star}}。

sents.en: Global references.
sents.zh: 全局参考。

sents.en: These use the subsamples of G G .
sents.zh: 这些使用 G G 的子样本。

sents.en: All distances is the Spearman correlation across 200,000 pairwise distances [ 40 ] .
sents.zh: 所有距离均为 200,000 个成对距离上的 Spearman 相关 [ 40 ]。

sents.en: Triplets is the accuracy on random triplets [ 41 ] .
sents.zh: Triplets 为随机三元组上的准确率 [ 41 ]。

sents.en: The median split is ν k ⋆ \nu_{k^{\star}} from Proposition 2 .
sents.zh: 中位数划分为来自命题 2 的 ν k ⋆ \nu_{k^{\star}}。

paragraphs.en: Because consolidation, deletion, the session, sector, and topic maps, and the global references compare each item against the whole memory, we call them the far-end operations. Across the 27 compressions of each run, we relate each operation’s agreement to L L and G G using Spearman correlation as well as the partial rank correlation with one fidelity given the other.
paragraphs.zh: 由于合并、删除、会话图、扇区图和主题图以及全局引用都是将每一项与整个记忆进行比较，我们将它们称为远端操作。 在每次运行的27次压缩中，我们将每个操作的一致性与 L L 和 G G 进行Spearman相关性分析，并在给定其中一个保真度的情况下，计算与另一个保真度的偏秩相关性。

sents.en: Because consolidation, deletion, the session, sector, and topic maps, and the global references compare each item against the whole memory, we call them the far-end operations.
sents.zh: 由于合并、删除、会话图、扇区图和主题图以及全局引用都是将每一项与整个记忆进行比较，我们将它们称为远端操作。

sents.en: Across the 27 compressions of each run, we relate each operation’s agreement to L L and G G using Spearman correlation as well as the partial rank correlation with one fidelity given the other.
sents.zh: 在每次运行的27次压缩中，我们将每个操作的一致性与 L L 和 G G 进行Spearman相关性分析，并在给定其中一个保真度的情况下，计算与另一个保真度的偏秩相关性。

paragraphs.en: LAQ is trained and tested on disjoint companies or conversations. For FinQA and Multi-Doc-2025, each split holds out a quarter of the companies (26 of 106 and 22 of 89). For LoCoMo it holds out two of the ten conversations. Three splits (seeds 2026 to 2028) were fixed in advance. A fourth split (seed 2029) was drawn after the LAQ recipe was fixed and run once with the recipe unchanged. PCA, OPQ, and LAQ are fitted on the training part only, and every reported number is computed on the held-out part using its own questions. Evaluating the three retrieval-tuned encoders across all three memories and Titan V2 on Multi-Doc-2025 yields 40 held-out runs, each comparing LAQ against its own OPQ start at d / 8 d/8 bytes. The other quantizers were evaluated on the first three splits. On Multi-Doc-2025, queries remain in full precision and are searched via ADC, just as an OPQ index serves them. L L , G G , and the far-end operations are evaluated on the stored codes. FinDER was run after all of the above, with the recipe unchanged. Each of its four splits (seeds 2026 to 2029) holds out 124 of its 497 companies, with queries searched by ADC. The three retrieval-tuned encoders thus provide 12 further runs, which we report separately from the 40.
paragraphs.zh: LAQ 在互不重叠的公司或对话上进行训练和测试。 对于 FinQA 和 Multi-Doc-2025，每个划分都留出四分之一的公司（106 家中的 26 家和 89 家中的 22 家）。 对于 LoCoMo，它留出十个对话中的两个。 三个划分（种子 2026 至 2028）是提前固定的。 第四个划分（种子 2029）是在 LAQ 方案固定之后抽取的，并以不变的方案运行了一次。 PCA、OPQ 和 LAQ 仅在训练部分上拟合，所有报告的数字都是在留出部分上使用其自身的问题计算的。 在 Multi-Doc-2025 上评估三个面向检索微调的编码器跨全部三个记忆库以及 Titan V2，共得到 40 次留出运行，每次运行都在 d / 8 d/8 字节下将 LAQ 与其自身的 OPQ 起点进行比较。 其他量化器是在前三个划分上评估的。 在 Multi-Doc-2025 上，查询保持全精度并通过 ADC 进行搜索，正如 OPQ 索引为它们服务的方式一样。 L L、G G 以及远端操作是在存储的编码上进行评估的。 FinDER 是在上述所有工作之后运行的，方案保持不变。 它的四个划分（种子 2026 至 2029）各自留出 497 家公司中的 124 家，查询通过 ADC 进行搜索。 因此，这三个面向检索微调的编码器额外提供了 12 次运行，我们将它们与那 40 次分开报告。

sents.zh: LAQ 在互不重叠的公司或对话上进行训练和测试。

sents.en: For FinQA and Multi-Doc-2025, each split holds out a quarter of the companies (26 of 106 and 22 of 89).
sents.zh: 对于 FinQA 和 Multi-Doc-2025，每个划分都留出四分之一的公司（106 家中的 26 家和 89 家中的 22 家）。

sents.en: For LoCoMo it holds out two of the ten conversations.
sents.zh: 对于 LoCoMo，它留出十个对话中的两个。

sents.zh: 三个划分（种子 2026 至 2028）是提前固定的。

sents.zh: 第四个划分（种子 2029）是在 LAQ 方案固定之后抽取的，并以不变的方案运行了一次。

sents.zh: PCA、OPQ 和 LAQ 仅在训练部分上拟合，所有报告的数字都是在留出部分上使用其自身的问题计算的。

sents.en: Evaluating the three retrieval-tuned encoders across all three memories and Titan V2 on Multi-Doc-2025 yields 40 held-out runs, each comparing LAQ against its own OPQ start at d / 8 d/8 bytes.
sents.zh: 在 Multi-Doc-2025 上评估三个面向检索微调的编码器跨全部三个记忆库以及 Titan V2，共得到 40 次留出运行，每次运行都在 d / 8 d/8 字节下将 LAQ 与其自身的 OPQ 起点进行比较。

sents.zh: 因此，这三个面向检索微调的编码器额外提供了 12 次运行，我们将它们与那 40 次分开报告。

paragraphs.en: On the held-out Multi-Doc-2025 memories, we compare LAQ at d / 8 d/8 bytes against OPQ and eight other quantizers. Five store codes of approximately the same size: PQ [ 4 ] , RQ [ 27 ] , LSQ++ [ 28 ] , PCA to d / 8 d/8 dimensions with 8-bit codes, and RaBitQ [ 31 ] with d d bits plus its per-vector factors (104 and 136 bytes). Sign and ITQ [ 30 ] binary codes are rescored on the 40 nearest candidates, and ScaNN uses anisotropic quantization [ 29 ] . All but ScaNN are fitted on the training companies.

paragraphs.en: Compressions of equal size keep different ends of a memory. Figure 2 a places every compression of FinQA with BGE-base on the ( L , G ) (L,G) plane; in Appendix C , Figure 5 shows both agent memories with the retrieval-tuned encoders, and Figure 6 shows the other three encoders. Within a given memory, the two ends correlate across compressions (Spearman 0.81 to 0.95 over the 18 runs) because fewer bytes lower both. Yet compressions with the same L L can differ widely in G G . With the retrieval-tuned encoders, half precision and 8-bit scalar codes keep both ends at 0.97 or above. PCA, PCA with 8-bit codes, and product quantization keep G G within 0.12 of L L , whereas binarization after PCA and a random rotation places G G 0.06 to 0.22 below L L . Among the linear compressions, rescored binary codes fall furthest below the diagonal, by 0.21 to 0.41. At 96 bytes per passage on FinQA with BGE-base, they keep L L at 0.97 but move 10.1 percent of the passages to another theme. PCA with 8-bit codes keeps L L at 0.77 and moves only 1.7 percent (Figure 2 b, c). Among nonlinear maps with BGE-base, UMAP to 16 dimensions keeps L L at 0.36 to 0.54 and G G at 0.10 to 0.20, while t-SNE and PHATE keep G G at 0.22 or less. Isomap keeps G G at 0.25 and 0.43. NPCA lies above the diagonal, with G G at 0.43 and 0.44 and L L at 0.22 and 0.24, as does PCA to the same 16 dimensions, with G G at 0.54 and L L at 0.35 (Figure 2 a, Table IV ). With the encoders of other kinds, PCA and product quantization lie on or above the diagonal on both the agent memories and the topic corpora (Figures 6 and 10 a–f). One-bit codes of GloVe and RoBERTa vectors reach G G of 0.58 to 0.81 at L L of 0.26 to 0.51. Because these encoders have coordinates of highly unequal variance, taking the sign of a low-variance coordinate perturbs the nearest neighbors far more than the nearer half.
paragraphs.zh: 相同规模的压缩会保留记忆的不同端。 图 2a 将 FinQA 中使用 BGE-base 的每一次压缩置于 (L,G) 平面上；附录 C 的图 5 展示了两个智能体记忆在使用检索调优编码器时的情况，图 6 则展示了其余三种编码器。 在给定的记忆内，两端在各次压缩之间具有相关性（18 次运行中的 Spearman 相关为 0.81 到 0.95），因为更少的字节数会同时拉低两端。 然而，相同 L 的压缩在 G 上可能差异很大。 使用检索调优编码器时，半精度和 8 位标量编码使两端均保持在 0.97 或以上。 PCA、PCA 加 8 位编码以及乘积量化使 G 与 L 的差距保持在 0.12 以内，而 PCA 后经随机旋转再做二值化则使 G 比 L 低 0.06 到 0.22。 在线性压缩中，重评分的二值编码低于对角线的幅度最大，为 0.21 到 0.41。 在使用 BGE-base 的 FinQA 上每段落 96 字节时，重评分的二值编码使 L 保持在 0.97，但将 10.1% 的段落移动到了另一个主题。 PCA 加 8 位编码使 L 保持在 0.77，仅移动 1.7%（图 2b、c）。 在使用 BGE-base 的非线性映射中，映射到 16 维的 UMAP 使 L 保持在 0.36 到 0.54、G 保持在 0.10 到 0.20，而 t-SNE 和 PHATE 使 G 保持在 0.22 或更低。 Isomap 使 G 保持在 0.25 和 0.43。 NPCA 位于对角线上方，G 为 0.43 和 0.44，L 为 0.22 和 0.24；映射到相同 16 维的 PCA 也是如此，G 为 0.54，L 为 0.35（图 2a，表 IV）。 使用其他类型的编码器时，PCA 和乘积量化在两个智能体记忆和主题语料库上都位于对角线上方或之上（图 6 和图 10a–f）。 GloVe 和 RoBERTa 向量的一位编码在 L 为 0.26 到 0.51 时，G 达到 0.58 到 0.81。 由于这些编码器的各坐标方差极不均衡，对一个低方差坐标取符号对最近邻的扰动远大于较近的一半。

paragraphs.en: This separation holds when conditioning on the other end: retrieval follows L L given G G , and with the retrieval-tuned encoders, consolidation and deletion follow G G given L L . Figure 8 in Appendix C gathers every operation across every run. Retrieval sits at the lower right, with a partial correlation with L L given G G of 0.83 to 0.99 (Tables V and VI in Appendix C ). Consolidation, deletion, and the session and topic maps sit at the upper left. With the retrieval-tuned encoders, consolidating the financial memory into themes follows G G . Its partial correlations with G G given L L are 0.68, 0.76, and 0.66 for BGE-base, E5-base, and BGE-large, whereas with L L given G G they are 0.04, 0.01, and − 0.02 -0.02 . Deleting a LoCoMo session has partial correlations of 0.86, 0.55, and 0.93 with G G given L L , versus − 0.11 -0.11 , 0.36, and − 0.14 -0.14 with L L given G G . The session and topic maps follow G G at 0.56 to 0.93 given L L , and the two global references, all distances and triplets, follow G G at 0.78 to 1.00. The operations defined on companies sit between the two ends. Peer groups, the barrier, and the company and sector maps compare 106 company centroids, making each a nearest-neighbor question in the space of companies. With the retrieval-tuned encoders, they follow L L (0.39 to 0.65 given G G ) at least as closely as G G (0.21 to 0.51 given L L ). In short, an operation follows the end of the profile at which it compares items.

paragraphs.en: Rescoring repairs the near end while leaving the far end tied to the stored codes. Disk-based vector search keeps binary codes in memory and rescores candidates using full-precision vectors read from disk; Figure 2 f, g reproduces this pipeline using the 40 nearest codes. On FinQA, rescoring raises L L from 0.74 to 0.97 with BGE-base, from 0.61 to 0.87 with E5-base, and from 0.77 to 0.98 with BGE-large. It lifts top-10 agreement from 0.57 to 0.87, 0.30 to 0.53, and 0.62 to 0.90. Yet G G remains fixed at the value of the binary codes, as does every operation computed on them. Theme agreement on the financial memory stays at 0.79, 0.63, and 0.82, and LoCoMo session deletion stays at 0.56, 0.35, and 0.57. Judged by a recall check, rescored binary codes appear close to the uncompressed memory; judged by G G , they keep only the far end of plain binary codes. The same pattern holds for every code family that preserves Euclidean distances (Table VII ).
paragraphs.zh: 重打分修复了近端，同时使远端仍与存储的编码绑定。 基于磁盘的向量检索将二值编码保存在内存中，并通过从磁盘读取的全精度向量对候选进行重打分；图 2 f、g 使用最近的 40 个编码复现了这一流程。 在 FinQA 上，重打分使 L L 在 BGE-base 下从 0.74 提升至 0.97，在 E5-base 下从 0.61 提升至 0.87，在 BGE-large 下从 0.77 提升至 0.98。 它将 top-10 一致性分别从 0.57 提升到 0.87、从 0.30 提升到 0.53、从 0.62 提升到 0.90。 然而 G G 仍固定为二值编码的取值，基于二值编码计算的每个操作也是如此。 金融记忆上的主题一致性停留在 0.79、0.63 和 0.82，LoCoMo 会话删除也停留在 0.56、0.35 和 0.57。 以召回率检查来评判，重打分后的二值编码看起来接近未压缩的记忆；以 G G 来评判，它们只保留了普通二值编码的远端。 对于每个保持欧氏距离的编码族，同样的模式都成立（表 VII）。

sents.en: Rescoring repairs the near end while leaving the far end tied to the stored codes.
sents.zh: 重打分修复了近端，同时使远端仍与存储的编码绑定。

sents.en: Disk-based vector search keeps binary codes in memory and rescores candidates using full-precision vectors read from disk; Figure 2 f, g reproduces this pipeline using the 40 nearest codes.
sents.zh: 基于磁盘的向量检索将二值编码保存在内存中，并通过从磁盘读取的全精度向量对候选进行重打分；图 2 f、g 使用最近的 40 个编码复现了这一流程。

sents.en: On FinQA, rescoring raises L L from 0.74 to 0.97 with BGE-base, from 0.61 to 0.87 with E5-base, and from 0.77 to 0.98 with BGE-large.
sents.zh: 在 FinQA 上，重打分使 L L 在 BGE-base 下从 0.74 提升至 0.97，在 E5-base 下从 0.61 提升至 0.87，在 BGE-large 下从 0.77 提升至 0.98。

sents.en: It lifts top-10 agreement from 0.57 to 0.87, 0.30 to 0.53, and 0.62 to 0.90.
sents.zh: 它将 top-10 一致性分别从 0.57 提升到 0.87、从 0.30 提升到 0.53、从 0.62 提升到 0.90。

sents.en: Yet G G remains fixed at the value of the binary codes, as does every operation computed on them.
sents.zh: 然而 G G 仍固定为二值编码的取值，基于二值编码计算的每个操作也是如此。

sents.en: Theme agreement on the financial memory stays at 0.79, 0.63, and 0.82, and LoCoMo session deletion stays at 0.56, 0.35, and 0.57.
sents.zh: 金融记忆上的主题一致性停留在 0.79、0.63 和 0.82，LoCoMo 会话删除也停留在 0.56、0.35 和 0.57。

sents.en: Judged by a recall check, rescored binary codes appear close to the uncompressed memory; judged by G G , they keep only the far end of plain binary codes.
sents.zh: 以召回率检查来评判，重打分后的二值编码看起来接近未压缩的记忆；以 G G 来评判，它们只保留了普通二值编码的远端。

sents.en: The same pattern holds for every code family that preserves Euclidean distances (Table VII ).
sents.zh: 对于每个保持欧氏距离的编码族，同样的模式都成立（表 VII）。

paragraphs.en: With the retrieval-tuned encoders, evidence recall follows L L , with partial correlations of 0.71 to 0.83 given G G on FinQA and 0.61 to 0.87 on LoCoMo (Figure 9 c in Appendix C ). Because financial text repeats across years, a retrieved passage can come from the right company but the wrong fiscal year. In the uncompressed memories with the retrieval-tuned encoders, 0.18 of the right-company passages come from another fiscal year, and every linear compression keeps this share between 0.15 and 0.24 (Figure 9 d).
paragraphs.zh: 使用检索调优的编码器时，证据召回遵循 L L，在 FinQA 上与 G G 的偏相关为 0.71 至 0.83，在 LoCoMo 上为 0.61 至 0.87（附录 C 中的图 9 c）。 由于金融文本在各年份之间重复出现，检索到的段落可能来自正确的公司但错误的财政年度。 在使用检索调优的编码器的未压缩记忆中，来自其他财政年度的正确公司段落占比为 0.18，而每种线性压缩都使该占比保持在 0.15 至 0.24 之间（图 9 d）。

paragraphs.en: Memories of the same size differ most at the far end. At d / 8 d/8 bytes per item, 32 times smaller than full precision, we compare seven compressions. Bytes per item count only the per-item codes. The PCA basis, the rotation, and the codebooks are shared across all items (5.5 MB with BGE-base and 9.4 MB with BGE-large, identical for OPQ and LAQ), while rescoring additionally retains the full vectors on disk. At these bytes, a memory can store one-bit codes with or without rescoring, rotated one-bit codes, product-quantization codes, d / 8 d/8 principal components in 8 bits, or OPQ codes with or without rescoring. Figure 3 a, b and Figure 11 in Appendix C compare these seven options, while Table VIII lists all 27 compressions on FinQA with BGE-base. On FinQA with BGE-base, rescored binary codes have the highest L L among the first five methods (0.97) but yield a theme agreement of 0.79. PCA with 8-bit codes keeps theme agreement at 0.96. The same ordering holds with E5-base (0.96 against 0.63) and with BGE-large at 128 bytes (0.97 against 0.82). The gap also shows by company. Even when every company keeps at least 91 percent of its neighbors, rescored binary BGE-base codes move a fifth or more of the passages to another theme for 5 of the 106 FinQA companies (Figure 10 g). With PCA and 8-bit codes, every company keeps at least 86 percent of its passages in their original theme. On LoCoMo, product quantization and PCA with 8-bit codes delete a session with an agreement of 0.43 to 0.68, compared with 0.35 to 0.57 for binary codes. Across every encoder on both memories, OPQ has the highest G G of the seven compressions, 0.82 to 0.86 on FinQA and 0.85 to 0.91 on LoCoMo. It deletes a LoCoMo session with an agreement of 0.70 to 0.82. When rescored, OPQ reaches a top-10 agreement of 0.99 to 1.00. OPQ thus keeps both ends best among the seven compressions at these bytes, making it the natural starting point for LAQ.
paragraphs.zh: 相同大小的记忆在远端差异最大。 在每项 d / 8 d/8 字节（比全精度小32倍）时，我们比较了七种压缩方法。 每项字节数只计入每项的编码。 PCA基、旋转和码本在所有条目之间共享（BGE-base为5.5 MB，BGE-large为9.4 MB，OPQ与LAQ相同），而重打分还会在磁盘上保留完整向量。 在这些字节数下，记忆可以存储带或不带重打分的一位编码、旋转一位编码、乘积量化编码、以8位表示的 d / 8 d/8 个主成分，或带或不带重打分的OPQ编码。 图3 a、b和附录C中的图11比较了这七种选项，而表VIII列出了FinQA上使用BGE-base的全部27种压缩。 在使用BGE-base的FinQA上，重打分的二进制编码在前五种方法中具有最高的 L L（0.97），但主题一致性仅为0.79。 使用8位编码的PCA将主题一致性保持在0.96。 同样的排序在使用E5-base时（0.96对0.63）以及使用BGE-large在128字节时（0.97对0.82）也成立。 这一差距在公司层面同样存在。 即使每家公司都至少保留了91%的近邻，重打分的二进制BGE-base编码仍使106家FinQA公司中有5家的五分之一或更多的段落被移到另一个主题（图10 g）。 使用PCA和8位编码时，每家公司都至少有86%的段落保留在原始主题中。 在LoCoMo上，乘积量化和使用8位编码的PCA以0.43到0.68的一致性删除一个会话，而二进制编码为0.35到0.57。 在两个记忆的所有编码器上，OPQ在七种压缩中具有最高的 G G，在FinQA上为0.82到0.86，在LoCoMo上为0.85到0.91。 它以0.70到0.82的一致性删除LoCoMo会话。 经过重打分后，OPQ达到0.99到1.00的前10一致性。 因此，在这些字节数下，OPQ在七种压缩中对两端的保持效果最好，使其成为LAQ的天然起点。

paragraphs.en: LAQ increases G G in all 40 held-out runs (Table II , Figure 1 h). With the retrieval-tuned encoders, the gain ranges from 0.005 to 0.017. Every gain exceeds the standard deviation of G G over subsamples, which is at most 0.0023. With Titan V2, whose OPQ start keeps the least of the far end, the gain reaches 0.032 to 0.038. L L increases in 34 of the 40 runs and stays within 0.0023 of OPQ in the rest, so the far end is gained with the near end kept.
paragraphs.zh: 在全部 40 个留出运行中，LAQ 均提升了 G G（表 II、图 1 h）。 使用经检索微调的编码器时，增益范围为 0.005 到 0.017。 每个增益都超过了 G 在子样本上的标准差，该标准差至多为 0.0023。 对于 Titan V2，其 OPQ 起点保留了最远端，增益达到 0.032 到 0.038。 L L 在 40 个运行中的 34 个中增加，其余运行中与 OPQ 的差距保持在 0.0023 以内，因此在保留近端的同时获得了远端。

paragraphs.en: The far hinge ℒ far \mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{far}} carries the gain in G G (Figure 4 a, b; Table X in Appendix D ). We retrained every held-out run with the same recipe and checkpoint rule and changed only the terms of Eq. ( 10 ). With reconstruction alone, training keeps the OPQ start C 0 C_{0} in all 52 runs, since OPQ already fits its codebooks to reconstruction. A near hinge, Eq. ( 11 ) at k = 10 k=10 or 50 on stored and ADC distances, raises G G by 0.0058 on average. Reconstruction with ℒ far \mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{far}} raises G G in all 52 runs, by 0.0127 on average, and above the near hinge in 48 of them (paired Wilcoxon test, p = 6 × 10 − 9 p=6\times 10^{-9} ). paragraphs.en: We test whether LAQ is better than OPQ with a one-sided Wilcoxon signed-rank test over the 52 held-out runs and correct each family of tests by the Holm method (Figure 4 f). Runs that share a corpus are dependent, so we repeat each test as a sign test over the 13 combinations of memory and encoder, each the mean over its splits. LAQ has higher G G , L L , all-distance correlation, triplet agreement, and median split at p ≤ 6.4 × 10 − 9 p\leq 6.4\times 10^{-9} over runs and p = 8.5 × 10 − 4 p=8.5\times 10^{-4} over the 13 combinations. Theme agreement and session deletion are higher at p = 0.028 p=0.028 and p = 0.046 p=0.046 over runs. Evidence recall@10 is equal to that of OPQ ( p = 0.84 p=0.84 , two-sided). The company-bootstrap intervals for G G lie above zero in all 52 runs (Figure 4 h).

paragraphs.en: LAQ has the highest G G among the quantizers of its size (Table III , Figure 3 h). In each of the nine runs with the retrieval-tuned encoders, LAQ has both the highest G G and the highest L L of all codes without rescoring. LSQ++, the strongest additive quantizer tested, reaches a G G of 0.73 to 0.77, against 0.83 to 0.87 for LAQ. With Titan V2, LAQ has the highest G G in all three runs, and ScaNN, fitted on the held-out memory itself, has the highest L L . With rescoring of the 40 nearest codes, LAQ reaches an L L of 0.995 to 0.999 in all twelve runs. This is above rescored sign codes (0.861 to 0.996) and rescored ITQ codes (0.938 to 0.994) in each run, and the stored LAQ codes keep the highest G G . Against each of OPQ, PQ, LSQ++, RQ, PCA + int8, and RaBitQ, LAQ has higher G G and L L in all 12 runs (paired Wilcoxon test, p = 2.9 × 10 − 3 p=2.9\times 10^{-3} after Holm correction; Figure 4 g).
paragraphs.zh: 在同规模的量化器中，LAQ 具有最高的 G G（表 III，图 3h）。 在使用检索调优编码器的九次运行中，在不重打分的所有编码中，LAQ 同时具有最高的 G G 和最高的 L L。 LSQ++ 是测试中最强的加性量化器，其 G G 达到 0.73 到 0.77，而 LAQ 为 0.83 到 0.87。 使用 Titan V2 时，LAQ 在全部三次运行中都具有最高的 G G，而在留出内存本身上拟合的 ScaNN 则具有最高的 L L。 通过对 40 个最近编码进行重打分，LAQ 在全部十二次运行中都达到了 0.995 到 0.999 的 L L。 在每次运行中，这一结果均高于重打分的符号编码（0.861 到 0.996）和重打分的 ITQ 编码（0.938 到 0.994），且存储的 LAQ 编码保持了最高的 G G。 相对于 OPQ、PQ、LSQ++、RQ、PCA + int8 和 RaBitQ 中的每一种，LAQ 在全部 12 次运行中都具有更高的 G G 和 L L（配对 Wilcoxon 检验，经 Holm 校正后 p = 2.9 × 10 − 3 p=2.9\times 10^{-3}；图 4g）。

paragraphs.en: These gains hold on FinDER, a memory built by others from the queries of financial professionals. It was run once, with the recipe unchanged, on 124 held-out companies in each of four splits (Table II ). LAQ raises G G in all 12 runs by 0.010 to 0.017, lifting the mean from 0.821 to 0.835. Every gain exceeds the standard deviation of G G over subsamples, which is at most 0.0025 here. L L increases in all 12 runs by 0.003 to 0.008, and top-10 agreement rises in all 12. Mean evidence recall@10 is 0.458 for both, within 0.007 of OPQ in every run.

paragraphs.en: LAQ also raises G G on a memory of one million passages. The memory holds 1,000,000 passages of MS MARCO [ 50 ] , encoded with BGE-base and stored at 96 bytes each. OPQ and LAQ were fitted on 100,000 other passages, and the 6,980 development queries search the memory by ADC. At this size, training draws a new subsample of 8,192 reference items at each step and chooses the cross pairs by their ranks within it, the argument behind the estimator of G G . It decodes only the items a step uses and averages the reconstruction term over 16,384 items. All other settings are those of the recipe. Over three seeds, LAQ raises G G from 0.774 to 0.784 to 0.785. The gain of 0.010 to 0.011 is about three times the standard deviation of G G over subsamples (at most 0.0039). L L , computed on the 10 nearest neighbors of 20,000 random passages, stays within 0.002 of OPQ. Top-10 agreement is 0.818 for OPQ and 0.818 to 0.820 for LAQ. Evidence recall@10, over the 820 queries whose relevant passage is in the memory, is 0.860 for OPQ and within 0.008 of it for LAQ. One training run takes 175 seconds and at most 10.0 GiB of one 48 GB GPU, and a second run reproduces the codebooks bit for bit.

paragraphs.en: Ordering cross pairs controls the far end, and this is what makes LAQ work. The bound has a leading factor near 2 across the G G band and near N / 10 \sqrt{N/10} at k = 10 k=10 . Reconstruction and nearest-neighbor objectives serve the near end. LAQ combines the two through a hinge loss at middle and far scales, a normalized reconstruction term for the near end, and a checkpoint selected on the far end of a monitor set. The ablation of Section VII isolates the far hinge: reconstruction alone keeps the OPQ start, and ℒ far \mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{far}} alone gives the full gain in G G in all 52 runs (Figure 4 ). The gain is largest where the OPQ codes keep the least of the far end, as with Titan V2, and it reaches the operations that follow G G .
paragraphs.zh: 对交叉对进行排序控制的是远端，这正是 LAQ 有效的原因。 该界在 G G 频带上前导系数接近 2，在 k = 10 k=10 处接近 N / 10 \sqrt{N/10}。 重构和最近邻目标服务于近端。 LAQ 通过以下方式将二者结合：在中远尺度上使用合页损失，在近端使用归一化重构项，并在监测集的远端选择检查点。 第 VII 节的消融实验隔离了远端合页项：仅用重构会保持 OPQ 的起点不变，而仅用 ℒ far \mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{far}} 则在全部 52 次运行中都获得了 G G 上的全部增益（图 4）。 当 OPQ 编码保留的远端信息最少时，增益最大，例如 Titan V2，并且增益延伸到 G G 之后的运算。

paragraphs.en: LAQ trains in minutes, between PQ and the additive quantizers, and keeps the query cost of OPQ. Each LAQ step costs about one k k -means iteration of PQ and OPQ [ 4 , 16 ] , plus a one-time ranking of the training memory. In contrast, additive quantizers spend their cost on encoding. RQ keeps several partial codes per item in a beam search, and LSQ++ encodes vectors by joint local search over all codebooks [ 27 , 28 ] . ITQ alternates a d × d d\times d rotation with sign codes [ 30 ] , and RaBitQ applies a random rotation without training [ 31 ] . On the Multi-Doc-2025 training memories, the faiss implementations [ 59 ] on CPU took 6 to 12 seconds to fit PQ, 146 to 517 seconds for ITQ, 511 to 1,193 seconds for RQ, and 8.2 to 17.1 hours for LSQ++. By comparison, LAQ took 35 to 112 seconds on one GPU after its OPQ start. LAQ and OPQ encode a new item in O ⁡ ( K ​ d ) O(Kd) time, while RQ and LSQ++ repeat their search for every item added to the memory. LAQ thus has the highest G G among these quantizers (Table III ) at a training cost between PQ and the additive quantizers.
paragraphs.zh: LAQ 在几分钟内完成训练，训练成本介于 PQ 与加性量化器之间，并保持 OPQ 的查询成本。 LAQ 每一步的成本约为 PQ 和 OPQ 的一次 k k-均值迭代 [ 4 , 16 ]，外加对训练记忆的一次性排序。 相比之下，加性量化器把成本花在编码上。 RQ 在束搜索中为每个条目保留多个部分编码，而 LSQ++ 通过对所有码本进行联合局部搜索来编码向量 [ 27 , 28 ]。 ITQ 在符号编码与 d × d d\times d 旋转之间交替进行 [ 30 ]，而 RaBitQ 应用随机旋转且无需训练 [ 31 ]。 在 Multi-Doc-2025 的训练记忆上，CPU 上的 faiss 实现 [ 59 ] 拟合 PQ 需要 6 到 12 秒，ITQ 需要 146 到 517 秒，RQ 需要 511 到 1,193 秒，而 LSQ++ 需要 8.2 到 17.1 小时。 相比之下，LAQ 在 OPQ 初始化之后，在单个 GPU 上耗时 35 到 112 秒。 LAQ 和 OPQ 以 O ⁡ ( K ​ d ) O(Kd) 时间编码一个新条目，而 RQ 和 LSQ++ 会对添加到记忆中的每个条目重复其搜索。 因此，LAQ 在训练成本介于 PQ 与加性量化器之间的情况下，在这些量化器中拥有最高的 G G（表 III）。

paragraphs.en: A compressed memory can be reported with ( L , G ) (L,G) against the memory it replaces, computed on the operator’s own vectors. L L says whether queries return the same items. G G says whether the memory keeps its far end: which items are consolidated or deleted together, and how sessions, companies, and themes relate. Neither needs labels, and G G is estimated from a subsample of 2,000 items. Where a memory serves consolidation or deletion, G G belongs in its acceptance test. The compression is then chosen as the one with the highest G G among those with the required L L at the bytes available. Theorem 1 adds a diagnostic: the violation rate of cross pairs at a scale shows which part of the profile a compression loses.
paragraphs.zh: 压缩记忆可以相对它所替代的记忆报告 ( L , G ) (L,G)，两者均在操作者自己的向量上计算。 L L 表示查询是否返回相同的条目。 G G 表示记忆是否保留其远端结构：哪些条目被一起合并或删除，以及会话、公司和主题之间如何关联。 两者都不需要标签，且 G G 是从 2000 个条目的子样本中估计的。 在记忆服务于合并或删除之处，G G 应纳入其验收测试。 随后在可用字节数下，从满足所需 L L 的压缩中选择 G G 最高的那个。 定理 1 增加了一个诊断指标：某一尺度上跨对（cross pairs）的违反率显示压缩丢失了画像的哪一部分。

paragraphs.en: The consequences are clearest in financial memories. A consolidation that groups filings differently changes the sector briefs an analyst agent writes. A deletion that selects different passages changes what a client request removes. Peer groups, the information barrier, and the company map compare company centroids. A check of these operations combines L L with agreement measured on the firm’s own companies.
paragraphs.zh: 这种后果在金融记忆中最为明显。 以不同方式对文件进行分组的整合操作，会改变分析师智能体撰写的行业简报。 选择不同段落的删除操作，会改变客户请求所移除的内容。 同行分组、信息屏障和公司图谱都会比较公司质心。 对这些操作的检查将 L L 与在公司自身企业上测得的一致性相结合。

paragraphs.en: Residual and additive codebooks are natural next targets for this objective, and sampling reference items already extends training to one million passages (Section VII-E ).
paragraphs.zh: 残差码本和加性码本是该目标的天然后续研究对象，而采样参考项已将训练扩展到一百万个段落（第 VII-E 节）。

paragraphs.en: Agent memories are compressed and accepted by their nearest neighbors, even though agents also consolidate, delete, and map what they hold. One label-free profile measures both ends. Its near end predicts retrieval, and with retrieval-tuned encoders its far end predicts consolidation and deletion, each beyond the other. Our main result is that the order of near and far items bounds the profile at every scale, and that this bound can be trained. Locality-aware quantization (LAQ) learns this order and raises the global fidelity of every held-out memory at the same bytes and search as the OPQ index it replaces. To our knowledge, LAQ is the first quantizer whose objective comes from a proven bound on the far end of a memory. It needs no labels and no change at query time, and it applies wherever embeddings are compressed and then clustered, deduplicated, or mapped. For agent memory, ( L , G ) (L,G) gives an acceptance test for both ends, and LAQ gives a way to pass it.
paragraphs.zh: 智能体的记忆会被压缩，并被它们最近的邻居接受，即使智能体也会整合、删除和映射它们所持有的内容。 一个免标签的指标同时测量两端。 其近端预测检索，而使用针对检索调优的编码器时，其远端预测整合与删除，各自超越对方。 我们的主要结果是，近端与远端条目的顺序在每个尺度上约束该指标，而且这一约束是可以训练的。 位置感知量化（LAQ）学习这种顺序，并在与它所替代的 OPQ 索引相同的字节和搜索量下，提升每条留出记忆的全局保真度。 据我们所知，LAQ 是第一个其目标来自记忆远端已证明约束的量化器。 它不需要标签，也不需要在查询时做任何改变，并且适用于任何先压缩嵌入再进行聚类、去重或映射的场景。 对于智能体记忆，(L,G) 为两端提供了一种验收测试，而 LAQ 提供了通过该测试的方法。

sents.en: Agent memories are compressed and accepted by their nearest neighbors, even though agents also consolidate, delete, and map what they hold.
sents.zh: 智能体的记忆会被压缩，并被它们最近的邻居接受，即使智能体也会整合、删除和映射它们所持有的内容。

sents.en: One label-free profile measures both ends.
sents.zh: 一个免标签的指标同时测量两端。

sents.en: Its near end predicts retrieval, and with retrieval-tuned encoders its far end predicts consolidation and deletion, each beyond the other.
sents.zh: 其近端预测检索，而使用针对检索调优的编码器时，其远端预测整合与删除，各自超越对方。

sents.en: Our main result is that the order of near and far items bounds the profile at every scale, and that this bound can be trained.
sents.zh: 我们的主要结果是，近端与远端条目的顺序在每个尺度上约束该指标，而且这一约束是可以训练的。

sents.en: Locality-aware quantization (LAQ) learns this order and raises the global fidelity of every held-out memory at the same bytes and search as the OPQ index it replaces.
sents.zh: 位置感知量化（LAQ）学习这种顺序，并在与它所替代的 OPQ 索引相同的字节和搜索量下，提升每条留出记忆的全局保真度。

sents.en: To our knowledge, LAQ is the first quantizer whose objective comes from a proven bound on the far end of a memory.
sents.zh: 据我们所知，LAQ 是第一个其目标来自记忆远端已证明约束的量化器。

sents.en: It needs no labels and no change at query time, and it applies wherever embeddings are compressed and then clustered, deduplicated, or mapped.
sents.zh: 它不需要标签，也不需要在查询时做任何改变，并且适用于任何先压缩嵌入再进行聚类、去重或映射的场景。

sents.en: For agent memory, ( L , G ) (L,G) gives an acceptance test for both ends, and LAQ gives a way to pass it.
sents.zh: 对于智能体记忆，(L,G) 为两端提供了一种验收测试，而 LAQ 提供了通过该测试的方法。

paragraphs.en: The figures and tables of this appendix give every run behind the main figures. Figure 5 places the 27 compressions of the two agent memories on the ( L , G ) (L,G) plane for the retrieval-tuned encoders, and Figure 6 for the three encoders of other kinds. Figures 7 and 8 relate each operation to L L and G G , and Figure 9 gives rescoring. The topic corpora repeat the pattern of the agent memories: Figure 10 places their compressions on the plane and breaks the 96-byte comparison of FinQA down by company. Figure 11 gives the seven compressions at d / 8 d/8 bytes. Tables IV – VIII give the nonlinear maps, the correlations behind Figures 7 and 8 , rescoring for every code family that keeps Euclidean distances, and every compression of the financial memory.
